newsitem.title: JAPAN: Kobe rubber steady to higher in after-hours trade.
newsitem.headline: Kobe rubber steady to higher in after-hours trade.

text.p: Kobe rubber futures were steady to higher in after-hours trade on Thursday amid light short-covering by local investors and some trade houses, traders said.
Prices were unchanged to 0.4 yen per kg higher than the day's close. Benchmark June was steady at 147.0.

During the day, prices edged up after the yen weakened against the dollar. But the day's volume was thin at 2,079 lots. "All months gained at the opening on the yen/dollar factor, but the bullish mood was not sustained. Investors are more interested in grains now," a brokerage trader said.
